Coram : M.Y. EQBAL*, C. NAGAPPAN
c Specific Relief Act, 1963: D s. 20 - Scope of - Held: s. 20 preserves discretionary power of court- Discretion must be exercised in accordance with sound and reasonably judicial principles. s. 20 - Specific performance of the agreement written in a quarter sheet of paper upon said agreement since the said quarter sheet of paper was produced before the Magistrate in a criminal proceeding - E Correctness of - Held: High Court was not correct in relying upon the document although it was executed on a quarter sheet of paper and not on a proper stamp paper -
